bias.zh: 偏空 · 跌破 8 月低点

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS fell 8.1% on Oct 22 to $131.69, trading between $130.79 and $139.30 on 1.3 times average volume, with no 100-day average yet (74 sessions). It is below the falling 5-day ($138.8), 10-day ($147.6) and 30-day ($172.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Sep 28 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($160.73), and RSI is 30.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 10月22日下跌 8.1%，收于 $131.69，盘中区间 $130.79–139.30，成交量为平均水平的 1.3 倍；上市仅 74 个交易日，尚无 100 日均线。股价位于下行的 5 日（$138.8）、10 日（$147.6）和 30 日均线（$172.7）下方。MACD 自 9月28日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$160.73），RSI 为 30。

read.en: The drop lost the 5-day average and broke the $137.1–137.8 and $133.8 (Aug 7 low) supports, all now resistance. Resistance is $133.8, then $137.1–138.8 (Oct 15 and 20 lows, 5-day) and $146 (Oct 15 and 21 highs). Support is $130.8 (Oct 22 low), then $124.8 (Jul 29 low, the 52-week low). A close above $133.8 would target $137–139; a close below $130.8 would open $124.8.

SK hynix closed at ₩1,223,000 in Seoul on Oct 22, down from ₩1,294,000, after a ₩1,204,000–1,297,000 range. It is below the falling 5-day (₩1,248,000), 10-day (₩1,324,100), 30-day (₩1,634,433) and 100-day (₩1,878,540) and the rising 200-day (₩1,473,765). MACD has been below its signal and zero since Oct 5, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Sep 28 (₩1,394,888), and RSI is 29.

The close gave back ₩1.25 million (Jul 29 low, 5-day average), now resistance; the low held above the ₩1,183,000 Oct 20 low. Resistance is ₩1.25 million, then ₩1.33 million (Oct 15–16 and Oct 21 highs) and ₩1.39–1.40 million (SAR, Oct 14 low). Support is ₩1,183,000–1,208,000 (Oct 19–20 lows), then ₩1,060,000 (Mar 18 high). A close above ₩1.25 million would target ₩1.33 million; below ₩1,183,000, ₩1,060,000.
